text: Public GraphQL API that returns exactly the data you request in a structured format
quote: The Fireflies API is built on top of GraphQL... This API allows you to retrieve exactly the data you need in a structured format.

text: Users can generate their own API key from the Integrations section of their account
quote: Follow these steps to obtain your API key for the Fireflies API: 1. Log in to your account... 4. Copy and store your API key securely

text: API requests are authenticated with a bearer token in the Authorization header
quote: We use a standard bearer token authentication mechanism. This means that to make authorized requests to the API, you must include an `Authorization` header with a valid token.

text: An uploadAudio API mutation uploads audio files to Fireflies for transcription
quote: The `uploadAudio` mutation allows you to upload audio files to Fireflies.ai for transcription.

text: An API query returns a list of transcripts filtered by input arguments
quote: The transcripts query is designed to fetch a list of transcripts against input arguments.

text: An API query returns full details for a specific transcript by ID
quote: The transcript query is designed to fetch details associated with a specific transcript ID.

text: The transcripts API can filter meetings by attendee email addresses
quote: Filter meetings that contain any of these emails as attendees. Accepts an array of email addresses.

text: Search meetings by keywords in the title or in words spoken during the meeting
quote: Allows searching for keywords in meeting title and/or words spoken during the meeting

text: An active_meetings API query lists meetings currently in progress, so you can monitor ongoing team meetings
quote: The active_meetings query is designed to fetch a list of meetings that are currently active (in progress).

text: An analytics API query returns conversation and meeting metrics for teams and users over a date range
quote: The analytics query fetches detailed conversation and meeting metrics for teams and users across a specified date range.

text: Audit events can be retrieved through the API
quote: Audit Logs ([API](https://docs.fireflies.ai/graphql-api/query/audit-events#audit-events))

text: GraphQL introspection lets you discover the API schema
quote: Introspection is a feature that allows querying a GraphQL server to discover its schema.

text: A built-in Apollo Sandbox lets you explore and run API queries interactively with your API key
quote: For introspection using our builtin Apollo Sandbox, visit api.fireflies.ai/graphql and enter your api_key in the Headers section as a Bearer token

text: API errors include a friendly flag and helpUrls that link to documentation on how to resolve them
quote: Where relevant, includes field `helpUrls` pointing to relevant API documentation sections that explain the error and provide guidance on how to resolve it

text: Code snippet examples are provided for interacting with the Fireflies API
quote: Explore a wide array of examples where we have created code snippets that allows you to interact with the Fireflies API.

text: Example replit queries the questions asked by participants from outside your organization
quote: This replit allows you to query questions asked by participants who do not belong to your organization.

text: A webhook URL can receive notifications when transcription completes
quote: URL for the webhook that receives notifications when transcription completes

text: A Super Admin webhook sends notifications for every meeting owned by the team
quote: A Super Admin webhook notifies you of all team meetings owned by your team, allowing you to automate workflows, integrate with other tools, and maintain an overview of your team's meetings with a single webhook.

text: Fireflies webhooks connect to Zapier to fetch transcripts automatically once meetings are processed
quote: Connect Fireflies webhooks to Zapier to automatically fetch transcripts when meetings are processed.

text: Uploads can set the actual meeting start time when importing historical recordings
quote: Use it when importing historical recordings so the meeting is dated with the actual meeting start time instead of the upload time.

text: Official Fireflies MCP server connects AI tools directly to your meeting data, with both read-only and action tools
quote: The Fireflies MCP Server enables AI tools to connect directly to your meeting data without switching platforms or copying transcript excerpts.

text: An MCP tool shares meeting transcripts with up to 100 email recipients, with optional expiry
quote: fireflies_share_meeting - Share meeting transcripts with up to 100 email recipients, with optional expiry

text: An MCP tool moves meetings into a channel or folder, up to 5 at a time
quote: fireflies_move_meeting - Move meetings to a channel/folder (up to 5 at a time)

text: Create soundbite clips from a meeting transcript
quote: fireflies_create_soundbite - Create a soundbite clip from a meeting transcript

text: A Documentation MCP server lets AI tools search and retrieve Fireflies documentation
quote: The Fireflies Documentation MCP Server enables AI tools to search and retrieve information directly from the Fireflies documentation.

text: A downloadable docs file can be given to AI coding tools so they can analyze and debug integration code
quote: Upload the downloaded file to your AI coding tool. Instruct your tool to analyze and debug the code using the content of this file.

text: Connect Fireflies to ChatGPT through OAuth, without API keys, and query meeting data with Deep Research
quote: You can now connect Fireflies to ChatGPT using our OAuth integration—no API keys required.

text: Invite the Fred bot to live meetings, or have it auto-join calendar meetings, to record, transcribe and summarize
quote: Invite fred@fireflies.ai to a live meeting or have it autojoin your calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize.

text: Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and other meeting platforms
quote: Zoom, GMeet, Teams, +more ... Transcription in 100+ languages

text: Automatically records Google Meet calls with real-time transcripts
quote: Automatically record your Google Meet calls and get real-time transcripts.

text: Real-time notes and live transcription during meetings
quote: Real-time notes & live transcriptions

text: Meeting summaries include notes, decisions and action items
quote: Fred records, transcribes, & summarizes meetings with notes, decisions, & action items.

text: Summaries can be customized and are available immediately after every meeting
quote: Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.

text: Transcription is supported in over 100 languages
quote: Transcription in 100+ languages

text: Multi-language mode switches languages automatically from one meeting to the next
quote: Automatically switch languages from meeting to meeting with ease.

text: Identifies the different speakers in meetings and audio files
quote: Fireflies identifies different speakers in meetings and audio files.

text: AskFred AI assistant answers natural-language questions about your meeting transcripts
quote: AskFred is Fireflies' AI-powered meeting assistant that lets you ask natural language questions about your meeting transcripts.

text: AskFred can query across many meetings with filters to find patterns and combine insights
quote: **Multi-Meeting Analysis** - Query across meetings using filters to identify patterns and aggregate insights

text: AskFred keeps context across follow-up questions within a conversation
quote: Maintain conversations where follow-up questions preserve context from previous exchanges

text: Conversation intelligence and team analytics for admins
quote:
Conversation intelligence

Team analytics (for admins)

text: A rules engine gives admins automation workflows to control meeting access and privacy
quote:
Rules Engine

Automation workflows for admins to have control over meeting access and privacy.

text: Super Admin role can bypass team privacy settings to access all meetings in the workspace
quote: The Super Admin functionality allows you to bypass your team's privacy settings, allowing you to query all data in your team's account.

text: Enterprise private storage stores meeting data at your preferred location in dedicated cloud storage
quote: Private Storage on Enterprise to store your meeting data at your preferred location.

text: 0-day data retention policy with all vendors and partners
quote: Private Storage options, 0-day data retention policy with all vendors and partners.

text: Tag Fred in Slack to get answers, catch-ups and suggested next steps
quote: Tag Fred in Slack. He answers, catches people up, and suggests next steps.

text: Fred summarizes your email, drafts replies, sorts your inbox and tracks follow-ups
quote: Fred catches you up on email, drafts replies, sorts your inbox, and tracks follow-ups.

text: Free, unlimited voice-to-text dictation in any app you work in
quote: Fred turns your voice into clean text anywhere you work, with free unlimited dictation.

text: Developer program participants get premium features, Business-tier access and higher rate limits
quote: Participants will gain access to premium features and higher rate limits, ensuring a swift and successful project development.
